description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee anniversary search results within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It contains properties for the current year, next anniversary date, and date difference bounds, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeAnniversarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to encapsulate filter parameters for employee anniversary searches within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getThisYear
methods.description: Returns the year associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setThisYear
methods.description: Sets the year associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: getNextDate
methods.description: Returns the next anniversary date for filtering.

methods.name: setNextDate
methods.description: Sets the next anniversary date for filtering.

methods.name: getDateDiffMin
methods.description: Gets the minimum date difference for filtering anniversaries.

methods.name: setDateDiffMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum date difference for filtering.

methods.name: getDateDiffMax
methods.description: Gets the maximum date difference for filtering.

methods.name: setDateDiffMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum date difference for filtering.
